facts.fact: MFWA reports that police arrested opposition NPP figures Kwame Baffoe and Abubakar Yakubu on 13 April 2026 over online publications, under the false news laws.
MFWA reports that TikTok creator Isaac Boafo was arrested on 1 March 2026 in Kumasi and charged with publication and circulation of false information about police officers.
MFWA says it recorded 14 arrests under Section 76 of the Electronic Communications Act and Section 208 of the Criminal Offences Act in the 16 months since 7 January 2025.
The Media Foundation for West Africa criticised, on 21 May 2026, the use of Section 76 of the Electronic Communications Act and Section 208 of the Criminal Offences Act and called for their repeal.
